About the RWBTC Women Only Friday AM Recovery Ride group ride

A gentle hour-long women-only ride from Cyclery USA in downtown Redlands. Hosted by the Redlands Water Bottle Transit Company, the local recreational club. The club also posts B, C and D level rides most Saturdays at 7:00 am.
